name: Xīwàng zhī Xīng
summary: 本游戏目前的游戏内容开发完成度很低，本人正在持续开发更新中，如果您期望购买后立即体验到完整的游戏体验，那么您不应该在此时购入。这是一款独立制作的横版动作角色扮演类单机游戏，玩家通过控制主角及其同伴在架空的异世界大陆中进行冒险。

name: Xīn Dòuluó Dàlù: Dònghuà Kǎpái Xīn Bàzhǔ!
summary: A popular game adaptation of the chinese manhua/novel/anime Soul Land/Douluo Dalu/Combat Continent by the author TangJiaSanShao. Free gifts and perks available to enable free players to thrive even without recharging or spending money. Experience the awesome storyline and unlock new features as you progress through the game

name: Xīngjì Shéngé
summary: A turn-based story-adventure sci-fi role-playing game. It's not big, the player's operation is very simple, just watch the plot, operate the movement and quickly select it in the battle interface. There are some simple side differences, and the overall exploration is up to two hours.

name: Xīng zhī Chuánshuō
summary: Explore a strategy-type RPG, collect equipment, abilities, and upgrades in an open world. After capturing the five magic palaces. The causes of jihad and the rise and fall of civilizations in the Primordial Age can be identified.

name: Xīn Shéndiāo Xiálǚ zhī Wánjiépiān
summary:
Xin Shen Diao Xia Lu Zhi Wanjie Pian is the second installment in the series based on Louis Cha's (better known by his pen name Jin Yong) The Return of the Condor Heroes. Players will control Yang Guo who finds out that his lover Xiaolongnü is still alive after 16 years and sets out to find her.

The game plays like an RPG. Players move Yang Guo using the mouse and battles use a turn-based system where each character out of a party of up to 3 characters can attack as soon as their meter is full.

name: Xīn Suǒ Xiàngwǎng de Běijíxīng
summary: A text adventure game that combines the elements of beauty, suspense and love. A visual novel game, the player takes the role of the main character in the story and uses options to advance the story to different endings.

name: Xīnnián
summary: A 4-player asymmetric game, where an ancestral dragon wants to take soul from New Year Festival while they try to escape.
